Disclaimer.Body:
Random & Everywhere Companion is an unofficial community tool, not affiliated with HPG, Microsoft or Asobo. No proprietary aircraft files are included.

It can install/update R&E packages, overwrite selected files, rebuild layouts and the mission index, play recorded packs or synthetic voices, and create local logs and backups. Audio modes remain separate. Optional H145 build 500 maintenance downloads applicable patches from configured public sources only when needed; otherwise it refreshes aircraft layouts.

Close MSFS before installation or maintenance. Verify the paths and keep an independent backup. Original archives and recordings are preserved.
